# Med Flow System

> Medical billing and revenue cycle management for small US healthcare practices (1-10 providers). Services: claim submission, eligibility verification, denial management and appeals, AR follow-up, medical coding, provider credentialing, prior authorization, patient billing.

Med Flow System (https://www.medflowsystem.co) is a US medical billing company based in Pittsburgh, PA, serving small healthcare practices nationwide. Contact: +1 (213) 890-6560.

## Services

- [Medical Billing and Claim Submission](https://www.medflowsystem.co/services/medical-billing-and-claim-submission): accurate, on-time claim submission with pre-submission review.
- [Insurance Eligibility and Benefits Verification](https://www.medflowsystem.co/services/insurance-eligibility-and-benefits-verification): coverage verified before the visit.
- [Advanced Eligibility Verification](https://www.medflowsystem.co/services/advanced-eligibility-verification): multi-touch checks, secondary coverage discovery.
- [Accounts Receivable Follow-up](https://www.medflowsystem.co/services/accounts-receivable-follow-up): systematic payer follow-up; MGMA benchmark is 30-35 days in AR.
- [Denial Management and Appeals](https://www.medflowsystem.co/services/denial-management-and-appeals): root-cause analysis and appeals; MGMA first-pass denial benchmark is 7-8%, under 5% is achievable.
- [Medical Coding](https://www.medflowsystem.co/services/medical-coding): CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS coding with quality review.
- [Provider Credentialing](https://www.medflowsystem.co/services/provider-credentialing): commercial credentialing takes 90-120 days, Medicaid up to 6 months.
- [Prior Authorization](https://www.medflowsystem.co/services/prior-authorization): authorizations secured before the date of service.
- [Patient Billing and Statements](https://www.medflowsystem.co/services/patient-billing-and-statements): clear statements and balance follow-up.

## Key facts

- Pricing: typically 4-9% of monthly collections; small practices usually pay 5-7% for full-service billing (2026).
- A full-time in-house biller costs $85,000-$110,000/year fully loaded (salary $60k-80k + ~30% benefits/tax + software).
- About one-third of US practices outsource billing (HBMA).
- AMA 2026 survey: physicians handle ~40 prior authorizations/week, ~13 hours of staff time; 95% report care delays.
